samples.summary: Autofit-grow commit rule changed but is documented only in the format-panel design doc, not in its canonical subsystem doc
samples.evidence: `editor.ts:4432` now writes `{x, y, h}` (anchored via `resizeFrameToSize`) instead of `{h}` on the autofit-grow commit, and `text-box-editor.ts` now moves the live container's `left`/`top` while growing. The canonical owner of that behaviour, `docs/design/slides/slides-text-autofit.md` §Persistence (line 219-225: "`onCommit` writes `frame.h = max(MIN_TEXT_BOX_H, contentHeight)` via `store.updateElementFrame(...)`"), is unchanged; the new rule is recorded instead in `slides-format-options-panel.md` §"W/H on a rotated element". CONTRIBUTING/design-doc discipline wants the rule folded into the subsystem doc that owns the path (or at least cross-linked), otherwise a reader of the autofit doc gets the superseded description.
searchedFor: Read docs/design/slides/slides-text-autofit.md around the Persistence section

samples.summary: Design doc's exhaustiveness claim ("the one other such caller") is inaccurate: two further changed sites are undocumented and other size-only writers on rotated frames remain
samples.evidence: The new doc section asserts the panel and "the one other such caller — the text autofit-grow commit in `view/editor/editor.ts`" are the only writers affected, and that "drag resize, crop commit and multi-resize already write whole frames". But this diff also changes `maskEditingElement` (editor.ts ~7430) and the live overlay positioning in `view/editor/text-box-editor.ts`, neither of which the doc mentions; and `store/memory.ts:1381/1407/1445/1487` (insert/deleteTableRow / Column) still patch `frame.h`/`frame.w` with x/y pinned on a possibly-rotated table, as does `model/slide-size.ts:39` (`scaleElementHeight`). The stated inventory is therefore wrong and will mislead the next author about which paths are already covered.

samples.summary: Scope beyond the panel W/H issue: text-editing overlay/underlay geometry and legacy-rotation NaN normalization are folded into the same change
samples.evidence: Beyond the panel fix (`frame-patch.ts` + `format-panel/index.tsx`), the change alters live text-edit container positioning (`text-box-editor.ts` `isGrow` branch), the in-edit underlay clone (`maskEditingElement`), the autofit-grow commit, and adds `rotation ?? 0` normalization in `resizeFrame`/`resizeFrameWorld` plus a NaN guard in the panel's `rotate90`. Each is defended in comments/doc as the same class of bug, but they are user-visible behaviour changes on paths the panel W/H issue does not name, which widens the blast radius of the fix. Worth confirming against the issue's acceptance list.

samples.summary: The "widen a size-only patch with anchored x/y" helper lives in the frontend while the slides package open-codes the same widening
samples.evidence: `anchoredFramePatch` wraps `resizeFrameToSize` in packages/frontend, but `editor.ts:4431-4436` performs the identical widening inline (`const fit = resizeFrameToSize(...); updateElementFrame(..., {x: fit.x, y: fit.y, h: targetH})`). The reusable form arguably belongs next to `resizeFrameToSize` in `packages/slides/src/view/editor/interactions/resize.ts` so both call sites (and future ones such as the table row/column writers) share one implementation of the patch-widening rule rather than two.
